name: Brittle
body:
School transmutation; Level sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a drop of corrosive substance)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target 1 object (see text)
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You reduce the hardness of an object by 5. An animated object or one in motion gets a Reflex save to negate the effect. If it is stationary or is not animated, it gets no save. The spell can only affect an object with an area of 15 feet square or smaller. If the object is larger (such as a wall), it only affects a 15-foot-square area.
